items.title: Lam Research’s Etch Moat Could Become the Most Profitable Lever in Next‑Gen Semiconductor Manufacturing
items.summary: Lam Research just clawed back 34% from a brutal selloff, and a $3 billion R&D commitment to next-gen etching technology suggests the rebound may only be the beginning. But whether the company can own the atomic layer etching era before a supercycle hits is the question every semiconductor investor should be asking right now.
